The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE)'s Volatility Index, or VIX, measures expected market volatility over the next 30 days using S&P 500 option prices. A key tracker of stock market volatility, the index moves lower the calmer markets appear.

With the S&P up some 16% year-to-date, and other equity benchmarks also touching record highs, the VIX dipped to 14.2 on Friday, its lowest level so far in 2026.
